review_scope: Static scientific and source-provenance review plus independent generated-data arithmetic checks; no real CT arrays decoded or new outcomes computed.

independent_generated_checks.finite_filter_reference: Independent full binomial coefficients comb(2p,k)/4**p, valid 1D convolution along each axis, p in {0,1,4}.
independent_generated_checks.ncc_reference: Direct numpy.corrcoef for all 729 shifts, all three masks and all three filter settings; centered support sliced independently of crop().
independent_generated_checks.declared_test_suite: All 9 test_local_structure.py tests passed in a separate generated-only execution.

static_findings: Finite filtering removes every touched boundary; maximum 4-pass radius plus 4-voxel translation fits 33-cubed input on a 17-cubed core.
FFT uses finite valid correlation, with positive XYZ shift meaning coarse(q+s); all mask-specific means and variances are recomputed at every shift.
All four input NPZ hashes are cross-checked against the exact published parent-result hash before decoding; pickle loading is disabled.
All 52488 shift correlations, 96 site-pair zero-shift comparisons and 36 structure records are retained; no affine or model input is altered.
Slab checks are explicitly descriptive and not independent holdouts; cached-grid support does not imply independent source CT support.
Exact-constant guards now precede numerical centering, resolving the reproduced 0.1/0.7 constant-array false-NCC defect.
Constant SD and variance-retention semantics are handled explicitly; undefined correlation is preserved as NaN/null.
The protocol does not infer tissue identity, anatomical truth, label-transfer permission or ink improvement from these metrics.
limits: This review validates implementation and frozen scope, not local anatomical correspondence.
Wrong-site comparisons are descriptive stress cases, not calibrated statistical nulls.
Adaptive development data and only a 134.47-micrometre nominal core cannot certify detector-context registration.
Synthetic checks do not estimate real-tissue accuracy; all real results remain unseen by this reviewer at this review stage.
